messages.subject: acviz: Advanced visualizations for irace
parts:
Dear irace users and colleagues,

We would like to announce the release of acviz: Algorithm Configuration Visualizations for irace, which provides visualizations of the automatic algorithm configuration process with irace: https://github.com/souzamarcelo/acviz

You can find the associated publication (open access) here: http://lopez-ibanez.eu/publications#DesRitLopPer2021acviz

We hope you find this tool useful in your work and research!

Best wishes,

Manuel.
--
Dr Manuel López-Ibáñez | "Beatriz Galindo" Senior Distinguished Researcher | University of Málaga, Spain | http://lopez-ibanez.eu
